hero.title: Close your tabs without losing your place.
hero.lede: cntxt saves every tab in a window as you work. Close the window whenever you want — all its tabs come back exactly as you left them, with one click, whenever you're ready for them again.

features.title: Every window is a workspace
features.body: Open a window, name it, and cntxt remembers it. No separate save step — it's just how a window works now.

features.title: Close it, restore it later
features.body: Done with a project for now? Close the window. Restore brings every tab back exactly as you left it.

features.title: Live sync, always
features.body: Open a tab, close a tab, move one around — the workspace updates in the background. Nothing to remember to save.

features.title: Jump with ⌘K
features.body: A command palette searches every workspace and every tab in it, so switching context never means hunting through windows.

features.title: Color and icon per workspace
features.body: Give each workspace a dot color and an icon. Glance at a window and know which one it is.

features.title: Move tabs between workspaces
features.body: Select a batch of tabs in one workspace and send them to another — no drag, drop, and hope.

steps.title: Open a window
steps.body: cntxt names it an untitled workspace the moment it sees tabs in it.

steps.title: Work like you normally do
steps.body: Every tab you open, close, or move is synced to that workspace automatically.

steps.title: Close it. Restore it whenever.
steps.body: The window goes away; the workspace doesn't. Pick it up again in one click, in any window.
